title: Article 62 — Time of holding election to fill vacancy in the office of President and the term of office of person elected to fill casual vacancy

content.overview: Article 62 provides that an election to fill a vacancy caused by the expiration of the term of office of President shall be completed before the expiration of the term. An election to fill a vacancy occurring by reason of death, resignation or removal or otherwise shall be held as soon as possible after the occurrence of the vacancy; in no case later than six months from the date of occurrence. The person elected to fill a casual vacancy is entitled to hold office for the full term of five years from the date on which he enters upon his office.
content.glance: Term-end vacancy: election before term expires. Casual vacancy: as soon as possible, within 6 months. Casual-vacancy President gets full 5-year term.
content.study:
Article 62 distinguishes:
(1) Vacancy by expiration of term → election completed before the term expires.
(2) Casual vacancy (death, resignation, removal or otherwise) → election as soon as possible after the vacancy, and in any case within six months.
(3) Person elected to fill a casual vacancy holds office for a full term of five years from entering upon office (not merely the remainder of the predecessor’s term).

Examination: pre-term-end election for ordinary vacancy; 6-month outer limit for casual vacancy; full 5-year term for casual-vacancy successor.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. Expiration of term: election completed before term ends.
2. Casual vacancy: election as soon as possible; not later than 6 months.
3. Casual-vacancy President: full 5-year term from entering office.

questionsAndAnswers.question: When must a Presidential election be held to fill a vacancy?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 62, an election to fill a vacancy caused by expiration of the term must be completed before the term expires. An election to fill a casual vacancy (death, resignation, removal or otherwise) must be held as soon as possible after the vacancy and in any case within six months. A person elected to fill a casual vacancy holds office for a full term of five years from the date of entering upon office.

examTips: Ordinary vacancy: before term ends; casual: within 6 months; full 5-year term for successor.

keyTakeaways: Art 62: timing of Presidential elections; full term for casual-vacancy President.
